checks.title: Session and capture continuity acceptance
checks.instructions: After all Slice 11 machine QA passes, use the real Control Center to resume an existing Session, start audio and screen recording, create a screenshot, restart only the Brain while capture is active, then verify the resumed Brain catches up in the same Session/Context. Finally stop recording and retrieve the created artifacts/transcript by time/type.
checks.expected: The user Session identity does not change because of the Brain restart; capture behaves according to the documented continuity guarantee; the resumed Brain catches up without replaying the entire transcript; created evidence is findable and correctly associated; no hidden data loss or stale toolbar state is observed.
